clusters.pick_reason: PR #2778 preserves the existing `# pragma: no cover` annotations on the `sse` and `streamable-http` cases, which are legitimately untested in the CI suite. PR #2745 drops `# pragma: no cover` from the `sse` branch and replaces it with `# pragma: no branch` on `streamable-http`, changes that are unrelated to the bug fix and risk introducing coverage failures. The core server.py fix is otherwise byte-for-byte identical between the two PRs.

members.title: fix: exit stdio server cleanly on interrupt
members.author: he-yufeng
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2778: KeyboardInterrupt raised by anyio.run() propagates uncaught out of MCPServer.run(), printing a traceback on Ctrl-C instead of exiting cleanly. Both PRs fix this by wrapping the match/case block in try/except KeyboardInterrupt: return.
